definitions.explanation: Areas characterized by fields, farms, and open land, as opposed to urban areas. Evokes a sense of peaceful, agricultural landscape.
Used attributively to describe things associated with an idealized countryside life, often with literary or aesthetic overtones.

examples.japanese: {田園|でんえん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっている→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: The countryside stretches out before us.

examples.japanese: ⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧{田園|でんえん}⟦{風景|ふうけい}→風景：03591_fuukei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: A beautiful rural landscape was visible from the window.

examples.japanese: ⟦{都会|とかい}→都会：02475_tokai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{離|はな}れて→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧{田園|でんえん}⟦{地帯|ちたい}→地帯：04057_chitai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}した→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧。
examples.english: I left the city and moved to a rural area.

examples.japanese: {田園|でんえん}⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{憧|あこが}れる→憧れる：05302_akogareru⟧。
examples.english: I long for a pastoral life.

⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{田園|でんえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{暮|く}らし→暮らし：02670_kurashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{美|うつく}しく→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧⟦{描|えが}いている→描く：02013_egaku⟧。
examples.english: This novel beautifully depicts pastoral life.

notes:
Composed of {田|でん} (rice field) and {園|えん} (garden, park). The word paints a picture of open farmland and fields, conveying a peaceful, often idealized image of the countryside. It has literary and aesthetic overtones that ⟦{田舎|いなか}→田舎：01320_inaka⟧ (countryside) lacks.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {田園|でんえん}⟦{風景|ふうけい}→風景：03591_fuukei⟧: rural landscape
- {田園|でんえん}⟦{地帯|ちたい}→地帯：04057_chitai⟧: rural area
- {田園|でんえん}⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧: pastoral life
- {田園|でんえん}{都市|とし}: garden city (an urban planning concept)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{田舎|いなか}→田舎：01320_inaka⟧: countryside — more everyday and conversational; can carry a negative nuance of being backward
- ⟦{農村|のうそん}→農村：04292_nouson⟧: farming village — focuses specifically on agricultural communities
- ⟦{郊外|こうがい}→郊外：01403_kougai⟧: suburbs — the area between city and countryside
